Based on the provided evidence, the maximum exposure limit for a single borrower/party (counterparty) for NBFCs is **25%** of the NBFC’s **Tier 1 capital** [RBI_RBI_2021-22_112_DOR.CRE.REC.No.60_03.10.001_2021-22__5914edf5_chunk_5].

This limit applies to the merged single exposure limit for both lending and investments [RBI_RBI_2021-22_112_DOR.CRE.REC.No.60_03.10.001_2021-22__5914edf5_chunk_5].
